label: First Council of Constantinople…: There is the Holy Spirit, the Lord and giver of life, who…
locator: art. 8 (Καὶ εἰς τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον)
interpretation: The creed professes this clause as an article of faith. The claim records what the creed asserts, read from the Greek division of the pinned witness; it does not claim the article is true, which the skeleton derives only from open premises. The Greek text says the Spirit proceeds from the Father, with no Filioque; the Latin Catholic addition is a separate candidate and is not read into this article.
